native_kernel_COMPLETE_seconds: The fused kernel timer spans candidate native FULL/freshSTA/route serialization/exports in its observer before cleanup. It is not comparable to the earlier callback-free native repair core.
connection_QUERY_seconds: Per-connection search/update/capacity-check duration before the candidate callback. Sum is a measured component and excludes pruning, initialization, callback and cleanup.
source_worker_child_seconds: Includes original LOAD/FULL/STA plus repair, candidate observer, source-restored FULL/STA and output; nested within worker request, not additive.
recovery_workflow_seconds: Current recovery segment consumes a previously sealed native worker with zero new repair calls; original worker creation and failed earlier Python stages are separate costs, not silently borrowed or combined into a cold timing point.
qualification: Source-inspected cost definition, not a measured speedup. Large validation/algorithm-controller summaries must use these distinct names rather than legacy native_core_seconds for a fused COMPLETE timer.
